analogy.rationale: Retinoid receptor binders act on RARA/RARB, which are nuclear hormone receptors; the most similar responses should come from other nuclear receptor ligands (retinoid receptor agonists, vitamin D receptor agonists, PPAR, LXR, FXR agonists) that share downstream transcriptional programs. Because these cell lines express little RAR, the overall response is expected to be weak.
